I unlocked her, but I have no idea how.  Here's everything that was going down.

GloomWeaver vs. Legacy, Dark Watch Expatriette, Argent Adept, and NightMist in the Realm of Discord

At the beginning of NightMist's turn, the following cards were in play:

 

GloomWeaver:  Grimoire of Curses, Bag of Bones, 2x Chosen Disciple, Cursed Acolyte, some number of Zombies

Legacy:  Incapacitated

Dark Watch Expatriette:  Assault Rifle, Submachine Gun, Pride, Prejudice, Hairtrigger Reflexes

Argent Adept:  Inspiring Supertonic, Rhapsody of Vigor, Akbunkh's Drum, Musaraghi's Harp, Eydisar's Horn, Sarabande of Destruction, Alacritous Subdominant, Counterpoint Bulwark

NightMist:  Amulet of the Elder Gods, Master of Magic, Tome of Elder Magic, Crimson Pin

I played Oblivion with a magic value of 1 and flipped two 4s:  Astral Premonition and Mists of Time.  I killed a ton of targets, I redirected the first instance of Oblivion damage dealt to NightMist with the Amulet.

 

My theories are that either a) It's just the amount of damage that is done in the turn or the amount of targets killed, not necessarily 2x 4s.  The 4s might just help by increasing the damage.

b)  I haven't seen anyone else mention it in their unlock so I'm probably wrong, but might it be that you have to redirect the damage with the Amulet?  Edit:  In fact, looking at the screenshot above and seeing that NightMist is at full health, I'd like to officially make this one my recommendation.  Someone else try it out and if it's true, I hope it's enough to get in the Hall of Fame :)

 

Just to be more clear:  Try playing Oblivion regardless of the magic value and then use the Amulet of the Elder Gods to redirect the damage that would be dealt to NightMist.
